title: Pocket Ramp
tagline: Pocket Ramp is a decentralized application (dApp) designed to help users securely lock their funds for a predetermined period. During this lock-up period, users are unable to access their funds, which can only be withdrawn once the specified time has elapsed.
description:
Pocket Ramp is a comprehensive savings app that not only empowers users to save effectively but also provides a robust support system to enhance the user experience. This support system leverages the XMTP messaging protocol, a decentralized communication layer, to efficiently manage messages between users and customer care, ensuring secure and seamless interactions.

To further streamline the user experience, particularly for those who may not be familiar with Web3 technologies, Pocket Ramp employs account abstraction through Web3Auth. This feature simplifies the sign-in process, allowing users to access the decentralized application (dApp) with the ease and familiarity of traditional web-based authentication methods, while still maintaining the security and privacy benefits of blockchain technology.
how_its_made:
Pocket Ramp is meticulously designed to offer an exceptional user experience for a savings app by leveraging cutting-edge Web3 technologies, including Web3Auth and XMTP.

Upon launching the app, users are guided through a seamless sign-in process facilitated by Web3Auth, which allows them to authenticate using their preferred method—be it a social media account, email, or traditional Web3 wallets. This flexibility ensures that both Web3-savvy users and those less familiar with blockchain technology can easily access the app.

Once signed in, users can select the amount of money they wish to save and choose the duration for which they want to lock their funds. The app securely locks these funds for the specified period, after which users can retrieve their savings.

To enhance user experience and support, Pocket Ramp integrates the XMTP messaging protocol. This decentralized communication system allows users to effortlessly connect with customer support, ensuring they can receive assistance or resolve any issues promptly. The use of XMTP guarantees that these interactions are not only secure and private but also efficient and reliable.
